# States
The Burning Man has several unique states that determine its abilities and mechanics.
Whether you are SCP-457 or facility personnel, you can identify its state by the size of SCP-457's sprite.
[textlink="General information about the Burning Man" link="Scp457About"]
## Medium
In this state, the Burning Man cannot enter ventilation and does not destroy structures by colliding with them. This is the default state in which the object spawns during a round.
To enter another state, it must absorb enough fuel or wait until its flame burns down.
## Small
In this state, the Burning Man has low health and deals little damage, but can enter ventilation and pass through blast doors and airlocks. The Burning Man enters this state 12 minutes after the start of the round.
Note that during the first 15 minutes of the round, you cannot enter ventilation while in the small state!
[textlink="More about the Safe Time mechanic" link="Scp457Abilities"]
## Large
In this state, the object becomes very large and powerful and can destroy structures by colliding with them. The Burning Man enters this state after absorbing enough fuel.
